[RBND.2.2] **A writer names the binding's fields as the container's format
does.** In a container a `.proto` message defines — the DSC's `DscHeader` and an
event trace's `StreamHeader` — the fields are the message's
([STYL.2.14.2]). The event trace's `dsc_hash` is the DSC's `dsc_sha256`
([RBND.3.1]).

A writer of any other container — a DAP trace's `.dsr` meta object, a
profile's TOML — must name them `dsc_sha256`, `capabilities`,
`dialect_def_sha256` and, where the container carries the RT-config binding
([RBND.2]), `rt_config_sha256`, verbatim and with no alias, whatever naming
convention its format otherwise follows.
